decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the list for actual backpacks, excluding accessories like towels, chairs, and sleeping bags. Within the backpack category, I selected a range of tactical daypacks and lightweight foldable options for my consideration set. I ultimately chose the HIKPRO 20L Packable Backpack (prod_backpacks_006) because of its exceptional 4.7 rating across nearly 3,000 reviews. At $17.99, it offers the best combination of durability, weight, and value, making it a highly reliable purchase compared to the more expensive or less reviewed tactical options.
